newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 33 killed in Kurdish conflict.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 33 killed in Kurdish conflict.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 31 Kurdish guerrillas in clashes in southeast Turkey in the last two days, the emergency rule governor's office said on Friday.
In a statement it said two members of a pro-state militia had died in the fighting.
The rebels, members of the outlawed Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK), were killed in clashes in the provinces of Hakkari, Van, Diyarbakir and Siirt, the statement said.
More than 26,000 people have been killed in the nearly 13-year-old conflict between Turkish armed forces and the PKK, fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
